_about: Settings and mappings for the dependency scan (data/stack.json). Every key is optional; a list or map given here replaces the built-in default. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored. See README, 'Configuring the dependency scan'.

checks._note: Turn a kind of lookup off; its cells then say it is turned off.

images._note: Limits for Docker image lookups: images looked up at once, seconds to pull and scan one, findings kept per image, version tags compared to find the version behind latest, pages of 1000 tags read.

groups._note: aliases: group names read as another. workflow_purposes: group of a tool a workflow installs, by a keyword in the workflow's file name (first match wins). by_ecosystem: the group of every Docker image and GitHub Action.

terraform._note: Registries whose providers are built from <namespace>/terraform-provider-<type>, so that repository's license and stars apply.

ecosystem_names._note: Names shown in the Ecosystem column and filter.

image_kinds._note: What a Docker image is, shown as its ecosystem: the first keyword its full name contains (in this order). Add a keyword to class a new image.

image_sources._note: An image's GitHub repository (owner/repo): its license is looked up there and its stars counted. Any spelling of the image matches.

image_licenses._note: A license stated for an image when nothing machine-readable gives one. name:tag is tried before name (redis 7.4 and 8.x differ). Wins over every other source.

license_aliases._note: License texts found in image labels and in PyPI metadata (license text or classifier), and the license id they mean. LGPL with no version stated stays LGPL.
